title: Static Glucose-stimulated Insulin Secretion (GSIS) Protocol - Human Islets
author: Aliya F Spigelman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wztff6n
materials: ALPCO Stellux Human Insulin ELISA kit

steps.title: Prepare KRBH Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare and warm the KRBH solution and ensure acid ethanol is available.

substeps.instruction: Warm KRBH solution to 37°C in an incubator (37°C, 5% CO2) for approximately 30 min.
pH the warmed KRBH solution to 7.4 using NaOH and bring to volume.
Keep KRBH solution in the incubator throughout the experiment.
Add glucose and/or additional treatments as required.
Pick human islets of similar size and shape into Human Islet Culture Media until as close as possible to 100% purity.
Culture islets overnight in an incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2.

steps.title: Islet Washing and Pre-incubation
steps.instruction: Wash and pre-incubate islets in low glucose KRBH.

substeps.instruction: Pick islets into a 35mm non-tissue cultured coated (NTCC) dish and wash with 2mL of appropriate low glucose (1mM or 2.8mM) KRBH.
Transfer islets into a new 35mm NTCC dish, add 2mL low glucose KRBH, and pre-incubate for 1 hour at 37°C, 5% CO2.

steps.title: Islet Distribution and Low Glucose Incubation
steps.instruction: Distribute islets into tubes and perform low glucose incubation.

substeps.instruction: Pick 15 islets per labelled eppendorf tube (perform each treatment group in triplicate).
Treatment groups for baseline phenotyping: 1) 1mM to 10mM glucose, 2) 1mM to 16.7mM glucose, 3) 2.8mM to 16.7mM glucose.
Add 500µL of low glucose KRBH to each tube.
Incubate for 1 hour at 37°C, 5% CO2 with tube lids open.

steps.title: Collect Low Glucose Supernatant
steps.instruction: Pellet islets and collect the supernatant for insulin assay.

substeps.instruction: Close lids, gently invert tubes, and spin at 1000 RPM in a benchtop centrifuge for 1 minute.
Collect 500µL of the supernatant (or as much as possible without disturbing the pellet).
Store supernatant at -20°C.

steps.title: High Glucose Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate islets in high glucose KRBH.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend islets in 500µL of high glucose KRBH.
Incubate for 1 hour at 37°C, 5% CO2 with lids open.

steps.title: Collect High Glucose Supernatant
steps.instruction: Pellet islets and collect the supernatant for insulin assay.

substeps.instruction: Close lids, gently invert tubes, and spin at 1000 RPM for 1 minute.
Collect 500µL of the supernatant (or as much as possible without disturbing the pellet).
Store supernatant at -20°C.

steps.title: Islet Lysis and Content Collection
steps.instruction: Lyse the islets to collect total insulin content.

substeps.instruction: Add 500µL of acid ethanol to the islets and vortex.
Store tube at -20°C until insulin assay.

steps.title: Insulin Assay
steps.instruction: Assay samples using the ALPCO Stellux Human Insulin ELISA kit (cat# 80-INSHU-CH10).

substeps.instruction: Dilute content samples 1:400 with zero buffer.
Dilute high glucose samples 1:10 with zero buffer if necessary.
